Scope: 20 ready-built factories of 900 m² each in five blocks (A to E), with external utilities, roads, parking and street lighting. Contract value 44,567,415.90 SAR.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. Weekly report No. 43 (data date 01-Nov-2026) reports the project 100.0% complete against 98.8% planned, 1.2% ahead. It gained 1.6% this week against 1.0% planned, closing out the remaining roads, fences, landscaping, building finishes and close-out documents.

All works are reported complete on 01-Nov-2026, 32 days before the contract completion date. The P6 update records all 1,827 activities complete, with construction finished on 29-Oct-2026, testing and commissioning on 31-Oct-2026 and initial handover on 01-Nov-2026. Close-out went from 0% to 100% in one week, and several activities that were open at the 26-Oct-2026 update now carry actual dates before it (see Data notes). The workbook's own summary still forecasts completion on 03-Dec-2026, and 33 field inspection requests remain pending.

Data notes

  • The weekly report workbook has no text version in MD Files; it was read directly from the original (.xlsb) file for this report. The P6 update and P6 report were read from MD Files.
  • Physical progress and the S-curve use the workbook's man-hour figures (116,776 budgeted). The P6 reports used for weeks 45 and 46 had a budget of 116,740; the 36-hour difference is procurement, where the workbook uses the earned hours as the budget.
  • The workbook's weekly physical figures (1,605 planned, 1,504 earned) are the same as in workbook No. 42. This week's gain (+1.6% earned, +1.0% planned) is calculated from the to-date figures of both workbooks.
  • Several activities that were open in the 26-Oct-2026 P6 update now carry actual dates on or before that date: steel fence and base plates (21–25 Oct), tree and shrub planting (19–26 Oct), street-lighting feeder pillars (finished 19-Oct-2026) and asphalt wearing course (finished 22-Oct-2026).
  • The P6 report now shows cost-based columns only, which are not used here. The P6 update file is coded HAL1-05-13 (HAL1-05-10 last week) and gives a planned start of 14-Mar-2023; its data date is 02-Nov-2026, one day after the workbook.
  • The procurement sheet has unit errors (for example fire pumps in m² and access control in m³).
  • The workbook summary still forecasts completion on 03-Dec-2026 with zero variance, while its milestone sheet and P6 show completion on 01-Nov-2026.
  • Report week: the Milestones sheet states "Current Contract Weeks: 47 of 52", which matches 332 days from site handover (04-Dec-2025). Workbook No. 42 also stated week 47, one week early; last week's report used week 46.
  • One photo is stamped 02-Nov-2026, one day after the data date. None has a GPS stamp.
